Excursions

On the tracks of the wolf

An evening excursion to hear the howl of the wolf, its biology, ethology, legends and its relationship with humans.

This experience is the opportunity to get to know this amazing predator, demonized and reduced to extinction over the centuries, but today is returning to repopulate so consistete the mountainous areas of the Alps and Apennines evening excursion has then a special charm, where you can find yourself in the middle of wild nature, rediscovering the senses, with a magnificent starry sky framed by us. We advise everyone to read carefully the rules of "Ecosofia," to help the guides to conduct a stakeout in full respect of the animals

Reserve / get information

Book online now!

Equipment

Hiking boots ,waterproof and windproof jacket (goretex possibly), backpack, long pants, flashlight., dinner. It is recommended to dress in layers, in the evening could be cold.

Meeting

At Ecotur, Via Piave 9 Pescasseroli at 7.30 p.m. with own car

How the reach us

Rome Highway 24, branch to Pescara, exit Pescina, continue to Pescasseroli.
